g.title: communication02
g.text: Communication 02: detected question -> streamed suggested answer (Primary slot)

g.title: assist
g.text: start_primary, then the spawned run_primary task

g.title: req->sink
g.text: 2.x.1: emit(AnswerStateChanged) [each set_state, if current or terminal]

g.title: note
g.text: 1.3: start_primary spawns run_primary; messages 2.x run in that tokio task.
record_latency also emits LatencyRecorded through the sink.
On Err(Cancelled): set_state(Cancelled); on another error: set_state(Failed, user_message)
and llm_health marks Llm Error / Degraded. With no LLM configured the request is
set Failed with "AI provider unavailable. Check provider settings."
